stem: A poultry farm near Rawalpindi, Pakistan, has 1,200 hens. For a random sample of 60 of the hens, the mean number of eggs laid in one week was 5.6, with a margin of error of 0.4 egg. Based on these results, what is the least plausible value for the total number of eggs laid in one week by all 1,200 hens?
solution: The least plausible value for the mean number of eggs per hen is \(5.6 - 0.4 = 5.2\).
For all 1,200 hens, the least plausible total is \(5.2(1{,}200) = 6{,}240\) eggs.
verify:
lo = Rational('5.6') - Rational('0.4')
tot = lo * 1200
assert tot == 6240
assert [Rational(a) for a in spr_answers] == [tot]
